cfg_dotfiles_dir.description: Path to the directory where dotfiles are stored (source dotfiles directory). Relative or absolute.

cfg_dotpath.description: Path to the dotfiles repository directory. Must be set if different from dotfilesdir.

cfg_nobanner.description: Disable dotdrop banner on startup. Equivalent to --no-banner.

cfg_workers.description: Number of concurrent workers for install/compare/update operations. Equivalent to --workers.

cfg_profiles.description: List of profiles. Each item is an object with fields: profile_name, dotfiles (list), config (object).

cfg_dotfiles.description: List of dotfiles. Each item is an object with fields: src, dst, link, preserve_mode, action, ignore, trans_install, trans_update.

cfg_transformations.description: List of transformation definitions. Each item has: cmd, cond (optional).

cfg_flags.description: List of global flags. Each item is a key-value pair (string keys and values).

cfg_ignore_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to ignore globally (e.g., '*.swp', '.git').
